header.title: Media
header.description: Screenshots, audio and video your server hosts, with a direct link.

errors.copy: Couldn't copy. The link is on the file name.

toasts.replacedPurged: File replaced. Anyone who already opened it may see the old one for a few minutes.
toasts.replacedSlow: File replaced. The new version may take up to 1 day to show up everywhere.
toasts.kept: File kept: retention will no longer take it down.
toasts.unkept: Retention is back: it goes offline on {date}.

replaceConfirm.title: Replace this file?
replaceConfirm.description: The link stays the same and starts showing the new file wherever it was pasted. The current file is overwritten and can't be recovered.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this file?
deleteConfirm.description: The file goes offline immediately and the link stops working wherever it was pasted (Discord Embed, moderation record). This can't be undone.

notConfigured.title: Storage not configured yet
notConfigured.body: The module is active, but the storage credentials haven't been set on the platform, so no upload will work until then. If you're responsible for the installation, see {doc}.

usage.title: Storage used
usage.retention: Files are deleted automatically after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.description: Reduces file size so more fits within your quota.

webp.label: Convert images to WebP
webp.description: Cuts about 30% of the size with no visible loss. Happens on upload.

video.label: Compress videos
video.description: Runs in the background after upload. The link doesn't change.

empty.title: No files hosted yet
empty.body: Upload with the button above or through your integration, using an API Key with the {scope} scope (create one in API Keys).

list.kept: kept, retention won't take it down
list.keepHint: Keep file: retention won't take it down (an LGPD deletion request still deletes it)
